items.title: Why Districts Should Introduce AI to Teachers and Staff Before Students
items.blurb: At the Sweet Home Central School District, outside Buffalo, N.Y., laying out a single after-school bus run used to take the transportation office about six hours, and a student who wanted a seat had to sign up two weeks ahead. Then the district built its own artificial intelligence routing tool. “We’ve reduced it into minutes,” Superintendent Mike Ginestre told Education Week in a recent interview
